an8.60:1.1: LX. Aṭṭh' ime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame aṭṭha? Sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno. Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an8.60:2.1: Cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā: esa saṅgho samukkaṭṭho sattānaṃ aṭṭha puggalā.
an8.60:3.1: Yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekhānapāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ ettha dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti. Sa-ādhānavaggo chaṭṭho.
an8.60:4.0: Tatr' uddānam: Gotamī ovādaṃ saṃkhittaṃ Dīghajānuñ ca Ujjayo Bhayā dve āhuneyyā ca dve ca aṭṭhapuggalā ti.
